page.layout: One printed page, mostly blank. A dark binding strip runs down the left edge. On the right edge, lower down, are two bold "X" marks, one about two-thirds down and one near the bottom of this part.; One column of marginal numerals and abbreviations running down the left margin. Small italic "c." and "v." abbreviations sit further right in the same strip. A partly visible number "8" at the top right.; One column of contents lines, full width, from top to bottom. Each topic line is followed by its scripture references in italic. Running head at top. No page number or catchword printed.
page.notes: The two bold X marks on the right edge are uncertain: they may be printed reference marks or signs, or they may be stains or show-through. No running text is legible in this part. The left-edge dark band is the binding shadow, not text. The top-right number "8" is cut off and uncertain. The left edge of the strip is cropped, so the first letters of "XVII." and "XVIII," are partly missing; "XVIII," is read from the visible "VIII,". The line "XIII." is read as XI II. with a possible gap in the scan. The abbreviations "c.." and "v." are cut short at the edge of the strip and may be longer in print. No running text is visible in this part. Ornamental bullet marks stand beside some reference lines and are not printed text. The left edge carries a partial stray letter that is not part of the printed text and is not transcribed.
